name: Travellog
description: A private, self-hosted trip planner and personal place check-in log.

jobs.description: Resumable import of an uploaded Swarm data-export ZIP into places, check-ins, and photos.

NOMINATIM_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Nominatim (or Photon-compatible) instance used for place search and reverse geocoding, no trailing slash. Defaults to the public OpenStreetMap Nominatim instance — point this at a self-hosted instance for higher-volume or more private usage.
